name: bapa-focused
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun test core/sized-sort.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1

name: bapa-typecheck
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit --declaration false > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1
